= Mathematics

Mathematics inside a line is written stem:[E = mc^2], and its notation is
taken literally: stem:[a_1 * b_2] keeps both the underscore and the asterisk
that the inline grammar would otherwise claim.

A block of mathematics stands between delimiters:

++++
\sum_{i=1}^n i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
++++

The attribute may be written out, which says exactly what the bare delimiter
already said:

[stem]
++++
e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0
++++

A passthrough block asks for its contents to reach the page untouched:

[pass]
++++
<aside class="hand-written">Markup cl-adoc did not generate.</aside>
++++

Everything else keeps escaping its output, so a < b stays readable.
